_README: Builtin command registry — visibility, display names, and help text for all shell builtins. Loaded by app/settings/commands.py. Values for 'visible': true (shown + executable), false (hidden + blocked), hidden (executable but not shown in ? — dev mode reveals it). 'configure_only': shown only in configure mode. 'hide_in_configure': hidden in configure mode. 'display': the name shown in ? help (can include placeholders). 'help': the description shown in ? help. Entries without 'help' appear in SHELL_BUILTINS for dispatch/completion but not in ? help rows.

arc.help: Application info and management  (arc show | arc ?)

cd.help: Change device or folder context  (cd device <name> | cd folder <name> | cd ..)

pwd.help: Show device, folder, TSG, and active account

folder.help: Manage SCM folders — list, create  (configure mode)

account.help: List or switch credential profiles  (Tab -> profile names)

set.help: Create configuration  (configure mode)  — set ? for sub-commands

update.help: Modify existing object  (configure mode)  — update ? for types

delete.help: Delete configuration object  (configure mode)  — delete ? for types

show config.help: List staged changes pending commit  (local — not yet in SCM)

commit.help: Apply staged changes + push to devices  (commit watch → follow the job)

abandon.help: Discard staged changes  (local only — SCM is never touched)

find.help: Search ALL commands (incl. disabled) — PAN-OS style

watch.help: Re-run a command every N seconds until Ctrl-C  (SSH session reused)

setup.help: Guided credential setup wizard  (auto-detects OS, two questions)
